capabilities.name: AI Execution
capabilities.use_via: packages/ai-execution with a project-side provider adapter
capabilities.can_use_now: Yes, as a reference implementation for execution request/result semantics and normalized failure handling
capabilities.notes: Atlas AI Execution covers execution request/result, failure normalization, fallback signal, evidence reference, confidence/risk, human escalation, trace, and outcome. Provider calls, request/response formats, retry/timeout implementation, prompts, model choice, RAG/Knowledge, business rules, and persistence stay in the project adapter. Validated through isolated read-only shadow comparison across multiple real project implementations without implying production model calls.
